cards.ex: After years of fighting, finally justice was served and the company was held accountable.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomidagi kurashdan so'ng, nihoyat adolat qaror topdi va kompaniya javobgarlikka tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Adolat o'z o'rnini topdi, haqqoniylik ta'minlandi degani.

cards.ex: Many people feel the punishment didn't fit the crime in this case.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilikning fikricha, bu holatda jazo jinoyatga mos kelmadi.
cards.uzDef: Jazoning jinoyatning og'irligiga mos kelishi.

cards.ex: The evidence was overwhelming; it was an open-and-shut case.
cards.exUz: Dalillar shunchalik ko'p ediki, bu aniq ish edi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar shunchalik aniqki, bahslashadigan joyi yo'q.

cards.ex: He's doing hard time for armed robbery.
cards.exUz: U qurolli talonchilik uchun qattiq qamoqda o'tiribdi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda qattiq sharoitda uzoq muddat o'tirish.

cards.ex: The police handled the investigation strictly by the book.
cards.exUz: Politsiya tergovni qat'iy qonun bo'yicha olib bordi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga va qonunlarga qat'iy rioya qilib.

cards.ex: He got off with a slap on the wrist, which angered many people.
cards.exUz: U yengil jazo bilan qutuldi, bu ko'pchilikning g'azabini keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yengil jazo, deyarli ogohlantirish.

cards.ex: The thief was caught red-handed trying to break into the house.
cards.exUz: O'g'ri uyga o'g'irlikcha kirayotganda ustidan tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat ustida ushlanib qolish.

cards.ex: The judge has to be above suspicion to maintain public trust.
cards.exUz: Sudya jamoatchilik ishonchini saqlash uchun shubhadan xoli bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubhaga sabab bo'lmaydigan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The police action was within the bounds of the law.
cards.exUz: Politsiya harakati qonun doirasida edi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy yoki qabul qilingan chegaralar ichida.

cards.ex: The trial was a travesty of justice; the verdict was completely unfair.
cards.exUz: Sud adolatsizlik kulgisi edi; hukm butunlay adolatsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatning juda noto'g'ri va adolatsiz ko'rinishi.

cards.ex: The company had to foot the bill for all the legal expenses.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya barcha yuridik xarajatlarni to'lashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni to'lash uchun javobgar bo'lish.

cards.ex: Eventually, the long arm of the law caught up with him.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, qonunning uzun qo'li unga yetdi.
cards.term: The long arm of the law
cards.uzDef: Qonunning ta'siri yoki qudrati, uzoqda bo'lsa ham.

cards.ex: He pleaded his case before the judge, hoping for a lighter sentence.
cards.exUz: U yengilroq jazo umidida o'z ishini sudga taqdim etdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z pozitsiyasini yoki ishini sudga taqdim etish.

cards.ex: The police arrived to serve a warrant for his arrest.
cards.exUz: Politsiya uni hibsga olish uchun order topshirishga keldi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ravishda orderni shaxsga taqdim etish.

cards.ex: The first trial ended with a hung jury, so they had to retry the case.
cards.exUz: Birinchi sud kelishmovchi hakamlar hay'ati bilan yakunlandi, shuning uchun ular ishni qayta ko'rib chiqishlari kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Hakamlar hay'ati bir fikrga kela olmagani sababli hukm chiqara olmasligi.

cards.ex: The prosecutor vowed to prosecute the criminals to the full extent of the law.
cards.exUz: Prokuror jinoyatchilarni qonun bo'yicha to'liq jazolashga va'da berdi.
cards.term: To prosecute to the full extent
cards.uzDef: Qonun bo'yicha maksimal jazo berish.

cards.ex: The evidence was stacked against him, making it difficult to prove his innocence.
cards.exUz: Dalillar unga qarshi to'plangan edi, bu uning begunohligini isbotlashni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar biror kimga qarshi to'plangan.

cards.ex: The Supreme Court decision was a landmark case that changed the legal landscape.
cards.exUz: Oliy sudning qarori huquqiy muhitni o'zgartirgan muhim ish edi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim, ta'sirchan sud ishi.

cards.ex: The company's business practices involved questionable ethics.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning biznes amaliyotlari shubhali axloqni o'z ichiga olgan.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy nuqtai nazardan shubhali xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: The judge threw out the case due to lack of evidence.
cards.exUz: Sudya dalillar yetishmasligi sababli ishni rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Sud ishini davom ettirishdan bosh tortish, uni bekor qilish.

cards.ex: You have to toe the line if you want to succeed in this company.
cards.exUz: Agar bu kompaniyada muvaffaqiyat qozonmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rahbarlar kutganidek, qoidalarga va vakolatga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: After the investigation, he was finally in the clear.
cards.exUz: Tergovdan so'ng, u nihoyat xavfsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdor emaslik, shubha ostida bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The police officer was accused of fabricating evidence to secure a conviction.
cards.exUz: Politsiya xodimi hukmni ta'minlash uchun dalil to'qishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Soxta dalillar yaratish yoki o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: She was called to give testimony about what she saw that night.
cards.exUz: U o'sha kechasi ko'rgan narsalari haqida ko'rsatma berishga chaqirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Sudda yoki boshqa rasmiy majlisda rasmiy ravishda ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: You must tell the truth when you are under oath in court.
cards.exUz: Sudda qasamyod ostida bo'lganingizda haqiqatni aytishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni gapirishga qasamyod qilgan holda.

cards.ex: He was charged with perjury for trying to mislead the court.
cards.exUz: U sudni chalg'itishga uringani uchun yolg'on guvohlik berishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Sudga noto'g'ri ma'lumot berish, yolg'on gapirish.

cards.ex: He hired a lawyer to defend his innocence against the charges.
cards.exUz: U ayblovlardan o'zining begunohligini himoya qilish uchun advokat yolladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining aybsizligini isbotlashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The court conducted a judicial review of the new law.
cards.exUz: Sud yangi qonunning sud nazoratini o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudning qonunlar va hukumat qarorlarini ko'rib chiqish huquqi.

cards.ex: The appeal raised a question of law regarding the admissibility of evidence.
cards.exUz: Shikoyat dalillarning qabul qilinishi bilan bog'liq huquqiy masalani ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun talqini yoki qo'llanilishi bilan bog'liq savol.

cards.ex: He chose to waive his rights and speak to the police without a lawyer.
cards.exUz: U o'z huquqlaridan voz kechishni va politsiya bilan advokatsiz gaplashishni tanladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z huquqidan ixtiyoriy ravishda voz kechish.
